description_expanded: Top Reasons to Book this Lovely Beach Cottage:* 3BR Home in WaterSound West on 30A* Beach Access over the Boardwalk-approx 1200 yds* 4 FREE Adult bikes!* Snorkel the Sea Turtle Reef-more info under Area Attractions below* Gated community with parks, winding trails and boardwalks* Zero-entry pool w/ cabanas, outdoor grill area and fireplace* Pool heated March 1 to summer, and over Thanksgiving and Christmas* Nearby Greenway Station - NEW Summer 2023!* Café 30A, Old Florida Fish House, and The Big Chill nearby* Only 3.5 miles to Seaside and 5 miles to Rosemary Beach* Professionally Managed; 24/7 Service*This property is not available to adults Under the age of 25. No Exceptions.* Anchors Up is a beautiful two-story cottage located in the highly sought-after WaterSound West community. This spacious 3-bedroom, 3-bathroom home offers nearly 2,500 SQFT of living space, providing plenty of room for family and friends to gather and relax in style. The home features a fully equipped large kitchen with granite countertops and stainless steel appliances, perfect for preparing meals. The sunroom offers a serene space to unwind, while the open-concept layout enhances the flow of the home, making it ideal for both entertaining and everyday living. Flat-screen TVs are available throughout, and the bedrooms are generously sized for comfort. With a king bed in the master suite, a king bed in the second bedroom, a queen bed in the third bedroom, and twin bunks in the TV room, Anchors Up comfortably accommodates up to 8 guests. For the kids, there's a fun kid’s living area with cozy bean bag lounge chairs, offering a perfect space for relaxation or play. The home also boasts a fabulous screened-in porch with a dining area, providing an inviting outdoor space to enjoy meals or simply relax in the coastal breeze. As an added bonus, 4 complimentary adult bikes are included, giving you the perfect way to explore the stunning WaterSound West community and the beautiful 30A area. Create lasting memories and start a new beach vacation tradition at Anchors Up – your ideal getaway on the Gulf Coast!*We LOVE Snowbirds! Low Monthly Winter Rates*Snowbird Season runs January thru February, on a monthly basis. To prepare a qualified quote, select your arrival date (must be the 1st day of the month) and the departure date (must be the 1st day of the month). Alternate dates must be pre-approved. All monthly rentals are subject to an additional $150 cleaning fee. Please contact us with your interest and to further assist!Families will love the amazing amenities at WaterSound West! This 256-acre, gated community is ideally located directly on the Gulf of Mexico between Seaside and Rosemary Beach. The seasonally heated, zero-entry neighborhood pool features cabanas, outdoor grills and a fireplace! Go exploring on boardwalks and; nature trails that wind through the community, over the large pond, and directly to the Beach. With Horseshoe Park and Deer Lake State Park nearby, a 9 hole putt-putt course, bike and kayak rentals available, WaterSound West is sure be the perfect peaceful beach vacation! ** Bicycles ARE allowed in the WaterSound West community on the streets. Due to safety and legal concerns, the WaterSound West HOA will no longer allow bicycles on the West Beach boardwalks. However, they are still permitted on the beach walkover, with the following provisions. (1) Bicycles must be walked from where the pavement ends at the clubhouse to the entrance of the beach walkover, where the railing begins; and (2) Bicycles must be ridden at the lowest possible speed while on the beach walkover. **Bed Setup:First Floor:Master Bedroom: King Bed- Private BathroomSecond Floor:Guest Bedroom: King Bed- Private BathroomGuest Bedroom: Queen Bed- Private BathroomTV Room: Twin over Twin Bunk BedAREA ATTRACTIONS: Greenway station is 30A's newest destination for gathering, shopping, and dining in Seagrove Beach. Greenway Station features known retailers Wild Olives Tapas and Wine Bar, Pecan Jack's Ice Cream, Coast Hippie and YOLO Board + Bike, plus introduces Local Cantina Mexican Restaurant, Souper Jenny Coffee Roasters, Canopy Road Café, and more.“The Big Chill” is the community center for Prominence and is a quick 10 minute bike ride your home or 1.6 mile drive. The Big Chill offers something for folks of all ages and tastes, from tacos and tequila, to wings, burgers and shakes, a stop here is quick, tasty and convenient, and comes with a side of entertainment at the outdoor amphitheater. It's a great place to catch a concert, sporting event, or a movie on the lawn. Seaside is a short drive away and is most widely known for being featured in the Truman Show with Jim Carrey. Its incredible architecture has helped to make it famous but also its faithful replication of the kind of seaside town that used to be common up and down the coast. Seaside has its own Farmer's Market, post office, Repertory Theater and neighborhood school. It boasts unique shopping, fantastic cuisine and the incredible architecture that makes Seaside famous. There are activities for everyone: kayak rentals, bike rentals, paragliding, fishing, golfing, hiking, swimming, tennis -- you'll find it all right here.The snorkelers in your group will love the new artificial reef called Sea Turtle Reef, deployed in 2017. Located just 783 feet out from the Grayton Beach State Park access, it is becoming a haven for sea life. Each of the 4 snorkeling reefs comprises 40 acres of permitted sea bottom. The Sea Turtle Reef is at a depth of 12-19 feet. We strongly recommend that snorkelers use a kayak, paddleboard, or other flotation device when visiting the snorkel reefs. Sea conditions can and do change quickly and often. Enjoy! Read less
